we report a novel approach for the efficient synthesis of RITA, a small molecule that induces apoptosis in p53-deficient cancer cells.

a novel approach to syntheses of substituted tricylic α-heteraryl analogues of RITAs, and the antiproliferation activity of these novel compounds.
